runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 03:26 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and Facebook public indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, qualification, economics, freshness and trust gates. LinkedIn surfaced Wolt Support Associate in Bratislava, but it is student/part-time shift work and explicitly requires English B2. Direct-company Alza results in Bernolákovo were accessible but warehouse/retail oriented; the predak role is shift/logistics leadership and outside the preferred light-duty target. Worki surfaced a Bratislava VZV warehouse role with three-shift/manual work. Brigada.sk surfaced an Avion retail brigade at 6 EUR/h. Kariera surfaced several current Bratislava administration roles; the strongest Office Manager at 1,750-2,000 EUR requires active English, while lower-paid reception/admin roles were not strong enough for LIVE. Upwork surfaced Worldwide WordPress/e-commerce/VA jobs, but current candidates were rejected for very weak fixed-price economics, strong English, 7-day availability, hard development or high competition. Reddit did not yield a fresh Slovakia-eligible concrete demand post. Facebook again produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Work-schedule burden gate
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Extract and score nights, rotating shifts, weekend duty, seven-day availability, on-call windows and mandatory response-time coverage separately from salary. This prevents apparently attractive jobs or gigs from ranking highly when their schedule conflicts with the preferred daytime, family-compatible work pattern.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Application language packet selector
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Store the application language explicitly and map each candidate to the correct Slovak or English CV/message package before response preparation. This reduces wasted time and prevents strong-looking roles from reaching the response queue when the practical application language is above the target level.
